narration.text: The future of medicine is changing, thanks to AI. Anthropic has revealed bold plans to develop new drugs.

Anthropic announced Claude Science, a new AI workbench for scientists. The Verge reports it aims to develop its own drugs. This pulls fragmented tools and datasets into one environment, generating figures and visuals.
TechCrunch reports Alibaba has reportedly banned Claude Code. It classified the AI software as high-risk. This shows major companies are assessing AI tools for internal use.
Midjourney is challenging Hollywood studios. TechCrunch says it wants studios to reveal their own AI usage. This is part of an ongoing legal dispute for transparency.

Google's new commercial imagines a Declaration of Independence. TechCrunch reports it asks what if Founding Fathers had Google Workspace. This highlights AI's role in creative and historical contexts.
That's your AI news for today. Which story do you think is most impactful? Let us know in the comments. And be sure to follow us for tomorrow's AI brief.

description: Catch up on today's top AI headlines. Anthropic is stepping into drug development, while Alibaba bans a major AI tool. Midjourney takes Hollywood to task, and Google imagines history with AI.
